choicesAndLimits: 200-tick pilots precede longer runs; all runs sequential, one seed (42) and one shared interactive host, no CPU isolation or confidence interval claim.

20 flies measured through the complete 6000-tick horizon; 100 flies measured for 1000 ticks only, because pilot projection exceeded 14 minutes. The longer-run 100-fly full-horizon estimate is 976.07 seconds, not a completion measurement.

Reserve capacity and initial reserve raised to 1000 with default positive idle/walk/fly costs unchanged. Closed occupied room and disconnected valid exit keep all brains active; no food, wind or hazards. These are benchmark choices, not campaign content.
Single odor source and production excitatory sensory adapter remain active. Body defaults, neural graph, noise and neural cadence unchanged. Shared field evolves once per tick.

Exact owner array payload excludes allocator, manifest, body/field/frame and process overhead. OS maximum RSS includes these. Initialization RSS understates later resident memory due to lazy page commitment.
Frames are dropped each tick; no replay archive, serialization, Worker transfer, browser/WASM runtime, renderer or browser responsiveness measured.

Total step-loop timing includes light telemetry and 200-tick stderr progress writes. Output serialization and process RSS sampling are outside it; the program measurementScope phrase excluding I/O refers to result-file I/O.
Pilot and longer-run rates vary; faster 100-fly pilot per-neuron rate is not evidence of beneficial scaling.
